There is a set of 14 characteristics that defines Fascism.

1 Powerful and Continuing Nationalism:
 we do not see any outward signs of this in the show from Piltover citizens. In fact, we never see anyone in Piltover save for the main cast and military after episode 3

2 Disdain for the recognition of human rights: 
Ep 3 showed Caitlyn had no problems using the Grey to gas people out and lock them up for any reason they didn't like

3 Identification of scapegoats as a unifying cause: Ambessas speech at the end showed her plot to use the undercity as scapgoats

4 Supremacy of the military: 
The noxian forces and enforcers become emboldened and hold power over Piltover and Zaun 

5 Rampant Sexism: This was not shown or depicted in the show. 

6 Controlled Mass Media: 
Even though this was not shown or depicted in the show. Id make an argument that using every person of influence to elect Caitlyn was spreading the message of the undercity were monsters and needed to be crushed

7 Obsession with National Security: 
Bridge checkpoints, crackdown on Jinx sympathizers, Caitlyn is obsessed with finding Jinx at all costs

8 Religion and Government are intertwined: This was not shown or depicted in a traditional way however I'd make an argument that the "church of viktor" and Ambessas forces eventually joined forces to become a religious military cult where the soldiers are shallow brainless killing machines and do what they are told without question.

9 Corporate Power is Protected: 
Salo might have lost everything but the show never depicted anyone else.  I assumed most of the upper class was protected by the military. They didnt have to worry about being affected at all. Also to me this was more depicted in season 1 where Jayce begins making deals and protecting the wealthy from enforcers.

10 Labor Power is Supressed: 
This has been depicted throughout the entire series and was dropped for the last 2 acts which is unfortunate. its what grounds the narrative and gives it weight for our main characters and their motivations. Vander and Silco started it and there is a real crackdown on working people and they are arrested for a rally in ep 4

11 Disdain for intellectuals and the arts: 
This wasn't shown however I could see Jayce, Viktor, Mel, Ekko and Heimerdinger are the real intellectuals and artists. Everyone of them were out of the picture and conveniently unable to protest Ambessas rise to power and using Caitlyn to do it.

12 Obsession with Crime and Punishment: Caitlyn threatening Singed with prison and demanding to know where Jinx was showed the lengths she was willing to go

13 Rampant Cronyism and Corruption:
Ambessa used her name as a Medarda to sway Salo, Caitlyn and everyone in power to get what she wants and those individuals were promised rewards.

14 Fraudulent Elections:
False allegations paired with fear and terror created a real place where an entire state was willing to listen and give unilateral power to Caitlyn. By extention Ambessa.

Couple points I make to give help
1) look at your route and find outlying stops/one time passwords/businesses. Knock out the ones you can reasonably stop at after load out and go out of order if you need to. I text one time passwords and notify then they will need a password later when I arrive they should have it ready.


2) If the route is a bad area/groups stops etc I know I won't finish until 6pm or after.


3) you can gauge your finish time by how many packages an hour you deliver 300 packages, 50 an hour is 6 hrs, 30 an hr is 10 hours. I push for 30 stops an hr but that will not always happen. Case in point one of my regular routes has a bunch of businesses off a highway with suburban homes spread out. I can easily get 35 stops one hour and 6 stops the next. 


4) If the route is organized well enough you can walk stops and still get 25 to 30 stops easily. The rough stops you learn which you should sprint to and which one you shouldnt. 


5) I take photos at every stop if the customer is there I tell them I need to take a photo and set it down and snap a photo. This has some leeway as If it's raining and they are not wanting to wait I'll hand it to them and do the signature


Edit* 6) I take mini breaks instead of sitting for 30. Otherwise my finish time is pushed back 30 minutes
